name: git-crypt
description: git-crypt — transparent git encryption. Protect sensitive files in git repos with GPG-based encryption. Non-interactive CLI.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/AGWA/git-crypt/releases/download/0.7.0/git-crypt-0.7.0-linux-x86_64 && chmod +x git-crypt-0.7.0-linux-x86_64 && sudo mv git-crypt-0.7.0-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/git-crypt
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.

commands.description: git-crypt — transparent git encryption. Protect sensitive files in git repos with GPG-based encryption. Non-interactive CLI.
